title: Cohort-normalized fixed-coefficient NSCLC spatial discordance transport audit
description: Corrected end-to-end reproducibility archive for an analysis-plan-locked post-deviation secondary transport audit of public multicenter NSCLC spatial transcriptomic data. The release discloses the G09-G10-G11 history, reconstructs the sealed Yale coefficients, repeats the locked Greek-primary and UQ-descriptive calculations from public inputs, and identifies the outcome as two-year truncated PFS.
